scope: Recover the three non-learning-valid routes from the first proportional checkpoint task without rerunning the valid Qwen success

recovery_design.trigger: The four-way run exceeded Daytona's observed three-sandbox capacity; Kimi hit EnvironmentStartTimeoutError and Flash/GLM were canceled at the shared 2400-second wall cutoff.
recovery_design.outcome_selection_guard: Every route lacking a learning-valid result is recovered; no valid failure or success is rerun.
recovery_design.concurrency_correction: Use the observed safe ceiling of three simultaneous Daytona sandboxes.
recovery_design.wall_timeout_correction: Use 3600 seconds so slow but active routes can finish twelve turns; this remains an infrastructure validity bound, not a success label.

effective_limits.wall_timeout_clock: absolute Unix wall time; includes laptop sleep

sandbox_budget.pricing_basis: same Daytona linear resource rates frozen for Gate 8 Wave 1
sandbox_budget.execution_policy: three concurrent Harbor trials, followed by a zero-sandbox cleanup check

interpretation_guard: Merge only the three recovered learning-valid rows with the preserved Qwen row; infrastructure failures remain excluded from training.
